scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The club sorter has seen only large dark leaf drawings. Small pale drawings appear in the next activity, and it makes more mistakes. Meera asks whether the learning set represented the kinds of drawings the class now expects it to handle.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A model cannot be assumed to work equally well on examples missing from its preparation. The team counts mistakes for each supplied group and keeps the group totals beside them. A single overall score can hide a problem with one kind of input.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: They add relevant illustrated objects with varied sizes and shades, then plan another separate check. They do not collect faces, names or addresses. Better coverage is about the task’s examples, while claims about people need much more care than this small classroom activity can provide.
